paragraphs: Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. You want AI to be safe and beneficial for users and for society as a whole. As a member of the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Forward Deployed Engineer who embeds directly with strategic customers to drive transformational AI adoption, operating autonomously and thriving under ambiguity while representing Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments. You will work within customer systems to build production applications with Claude models, deliver technical artifacts such as MCP servers and sub‑agents, provide white‑glove deployment support, and maintain strong knowledge of the latest LLM capabilities and implementation patterns.

The role’s requirement for LLMs aligns with my experience. I have built agentic solutions in Python backed by PostgreSQL and continuous integration, delivering stakeholder‑focused prototypes that demonstrate advanced prompt engineering and agent development. I also constructed MCP‑based search services using GraphQL and open‑weight models, integrating PostgreSQL for persistent state and CI pipelines to ensure reliable deployment at scale. These projects show my ability to create production‑ready applications with Claude models and to ship technical artifacts such as sub‑agents and MCP servers that meet customer requirements.

Research is another core pillar of the position. I designed an agent built on LangChain and deployed it on AWS Bedrock, addressing hallucination risks through API‑driven evaluation and producing a 19,213‑gene parquet fallback for downstream analysis. Additionally, I led systematic evaluation of model outputs, establishing metrics that inform safe and interpretable AI behaviour. Both initiatives demonstrate my capacity to advance safe, beneficial AI through rigorous experimentation and to translate research findings into production‑grade tools that support enterprise customers.
